trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Noel: Round and round these tunnels I go, checking the old props. And now I've found a trainer!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Noel: You've shaken me up more than any rockfall ever did.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Braden: My Steelix grew up down here in the dark, among the iron. It's as hard as the island itself!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Braden: Even steel can be beaten, then. Who'd have thought it?
